properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): seven cross-type refusals in one genesis, all thread pairs, none a duplicate — Capability↔Component (three of them the component named in the same call's `allocated_to`), Requirement↔Component, Component↔Component, Capability↔DesignRule — because PRESCRIBED_LAYER_PAIRS was deliberately limited to pairs with evidence and those pairs had none until today; and the guard never exempts the target the write itself declares a relation to
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL on xrt-demo F8 and the bhome "4th of 4 parallel writes" note, 2026-09-16.

① OBSERVED: seven `add_*` writes refused with the cross-type layer wording; each resolved with distinct_from; none was a duplicate. Three of the seven were a capability refused against the component passed as its own `allocated_to`. Expected: a write that declares its own relation to a node is not refused for resembling that node. NOT affected: same-type near matches (advisory, correct); the ten prescribed pairs.

② PRECEDENT: fact:twelve-near-match-refusals-across-two-designs-and-not-one-was-a-duplicate (2026-08-31, 12/0); chg:the-prescribed-layer-pairs-stop-refusing (2026-08-31) which fixed ten pairs and named Requirement↔Component as deliberately absent for want of a measurement; dec:idea-the-near-match-repair-can-now-be-reopened-because-the-count-exists.

③ CANDIDATES: (a) the prescribed set omits the thread pairs that fired; (b) the guard has no notion that the call's own arguments (allocated_to, satisfies) name the near-match — refusing on that ground is "the tool refusing a write because its own argument is too similar to it"; (c) the similarity threshold is too low; (d) the design vocabulary makes thread pairs share words by construction, so ANY content similarity guard fires hardest on the links the design most needs.

④ ⑤ MEASURED: (a) confirmed by reading PRESCRIBED_LAYER_PAIRS; (b) confirmed — refuse_unless_deliberate filters by is_prescribed_layer only, never by the request's declared targets; (c) cannot be separated from (d) by this report and is not claimed; (d) is the reporter's diagnosis and is consistent with 19 of 19 cross-type refusals across three designs being non-duplicates — but it predicts the same observation as (a), so it is recorded as the class, not proven as the mechanism.

⑥ CLASS: a hand-maintained allowlist standing in for a rule the design already states (the golden thread joins semantically adjacent nodes), extended one measurement at a time. ⑦ PIN: two tests written first — a capability created with allocated_to: cmp:X is not refused against cmp:X; Requirement↔Component reports and does not refuse — observed failing. ⑧ FIX AT THE CAUSE (his word): (1) exempt any near-match the call itself names as a relation target — that is not an allowlist, it is reading the request; (2) add Capability↔Component, Requirement↔Component, Capability↔DesignRule, Capability↔Constraint to the prescribed set on today's evidence; (3) leave Component↔Component (a grouping and its member) refusing until it is measured more than once, and say so. The 2026-08-29 counterweight stands: a same-type near duplicate still refuses. ⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: the miss rate — whether any cross-type refusal has ever caught a real duplicate; three designs and 19 refusals say no, which is evidence, not proof.
